title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang is 'playing both sides' of AI with Hugging Face purchase
title_zh: Nvidia 的 Jensen Huang 通过购买 Hugging Face 来“玩弄人工智能的两面性”
summary: Nvidia (NVDA) is buying AI platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion in a move that could extend Nvidia's reach in the AI ecosystem beyond being just a chip supplier.
summary_zh: 英伟达 (NVDA) 将以 129 亿美元收购人工智能平台 Hugging Face，此举可能会扩大英伟达在人工智能生态系统中的影响力，而不仅仅是一家芯片供应商。

title: AI demand is 'exceptional,' but the supply chain is not: HPE CEO
title_zh: 慧与首席执行官：人工智能需求“异常”，但供应链却并非如此
summary: HPE (HPE) reported third quarter earnings results on Wednesday. HPE CEO Antonio Neri sits down with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to discuss the relationship between the roaring demand for AI and the industry's extreme supply-chain constraints.
summary_zh: 慧与（HPE）周三公布了第三季度财报。 HPE 首席执行官 Antonio Neri 与雅虎财经执行编辑 Brian Sozzi 坐下来讨论人工智能需求的激增与行业极端供应链限制之间的关系。

title: How Nvidia's latest deal continues to target all points of the AI trade
title_zh: 英伟达的最新交易如何继续瞄准人工智能行业的所有领域
summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferré joins Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to report on Nvidia's $12.9 billion acquisition of Hugging Face, the company's bet on open AI models, and now accounting for 8% of the S&P 500 market cap.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经高级商业记者 Ines Ferré 与雅虎财经执行编辑 Brian Sozzi 一起报道 Nvidia 以 129 亿美元收购 Hugging Face，该公司押注于开放人工智能模型，目前占标准普尔 500 指数市值的 8%。

title: Whole Foods CEO bets on smaller stores and the latest Amazon tech to win over shoppers
title_zh: Whole Foods 首席执行官押注于小型商店和最新的亚马逊技术来赢得购物者
summary: Whole Foods received some rare praise on a recent Amazon earnings call — for good reason.
summary_zh: 全食超市在最近的亚马逊财报电话会议上获得了罕见的赞扬——这是有充分理由的。

title: Stocks edge up as Nvidia leads tech higher following Hugging Face deal announcement: AlphaCheck
title_zh: Hugging Face 交易宣布后，英伟达引领科技股走高，股市小幅上涨：AlphaCheck
summary: Stocks edged higher as Treasury yields slipped ahead of Friday's jobs report.
summary_zh: 由于周五就业报告公布前美国国债收益率下滑，股市小幅走高。

title: Why Nvidia's purchase of Hugging Face is an 'important strategic move'
title_zh: 为什么英伟达收购 Hugging Face 是一个“重要的战略举措”
summary: Nvidia (NVDA) will be buying open-weight AI company Hugging Face for $12.9 billion.
summary_zh: 英伟达 (NVDA) 将以 129 亿美元收购开放式人工智能公司 Hugging Face。

title: For all their talk about AI, few companies are quantifying gains
title_zh: 尽管他们都在谈论人工智能，但很少有公司会量化收益
summary: Is any money being made from AI?

title: How Apple's John Ternus inherited a 'reckoning' with China
title_zh: 苹果公司的约翰·特努斯如何继承对中国的“清算”
summary: Strategy Risks founder and CEO, Isaac Stone Fish, sits down with Market Domination host Josh Lipton to discuss various aspects of Apple's (AAPL) overall strategy in China, India, and more.
summary_zh: Strategy Risks 创始人兼首席执行官 Isaac Stone Fish 与《市场支配》主持人 Josh Lipton 坐下来讨论苹果 (AAPL) 在中国、印度等地区总体战略的各个方面。
